item.title: [Graph: New permission] Policy.ReadWrite.AuthFeatureToggle
item.description:
Entered permissions/new/permissions.json in Microsoft's Weekly Permissions sync of 24 November 2026, commit da9eba0 (branch permissions-update/2026-11-24, owner group hybridauth). Microsoft publishes it as “Read and write feature toggle policy” (Application) and “Read and write your organization's feature toggle policy” (DelegatedWork), admin consent required, privilege level 4, on GET and PATCH /policies/authenticationfeaturetogglepolicy. Not yet on the public permissions reference.
